notes.title: Leviathan: The Cargo
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/92LuV33.jpg?1[/img]

Lostwood proudly announces Leviathan: The Cargo.

Leviathan: The Cargo is a new action-adventure game that follows the story after the Last Day of the Decade continuing the epic saga of Leviathan. A gang of smugglers travels through the passages of Plague King's Tower carrying out the will of William Lautner, Darina Lautner's father. They have to deliver a sealed box with something really valuable inside... The new rulers of Kroistham send a group of Inquirers and the royal army under the command of a young, daring and zealous leader.

Glimmering subway passages and underground caves full of freaky demonic life - this is where the journey of Dan, Augusta, Monica and Zvi starts. The story of deep human fears, dreams, forgiveness and redemption will take you through green sunlit oases, wastelands and streets of an ancient city wrapped with glowing tubes.

The world of abandoned train stations, religious lore, immortal technologies and mysticism will open up in front of your eyes this year. Prepare to take your step towards it!

Will be available on: Steam(Windows, Mac, Linux), Android, iOS, Windows phone. Get all the up to date information at our [url=https://www.facebook.com/leviathangame]Facebook[/url] communities and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LostwoodGames]Twitter[/url].

[url=http://www.thelostwood.com/?page=cargo]Official Website[/url]

notes.title: Manifest — Seduction of an Artist
notes.content:
As you might have guessed, the game won't be released in February.

We are late, postponing and delaying the release due to a "seduction of artist". Our wish to improve the dramatic constituent of the story and to bring up the expressiveness to the highest level made us feel displeased of what we had achieved.

Leviathan: The Last Day of the Decade was an important milestone, it introduced the world and the setting to players. It was the very beginning of the Leviathan saga. It was. We love this game but there is no point in holding on to the past while we are looking forward to the future.

We've achieved a new level of understanding of what we do. Leviathan: the Cargo designates a new stage of Lostwood games' development and we want continue growing and to make the new game much more powerful, vivid and expressive.

Rules of business urge us to release The Cargo as soon as possible but it is not only about business. As a producer of Leviathan I'd like to say two things:

First: as a person who cares about the community, about all those people who love Leviathan, I want to say "I am sorry for postponing the game and feel regret for not releasing it in February".

Second: as an artist (seduced artist, you know) I want this game to be released only when we achieve the level of expressiveness and depth that we want.

[h1]Additional:[/h1]
- Secret photo is now displayed correctly,
- Fixed the credits video,
- You can no longer farm gold infinitely,
- Fixed z-fighting issues (Kael in the cafe in ep3, gargoyle on the roof in ep2, and some more),
- No more "tDarina",
- Fixed text ID being displayed instead of correct text in episode 5,
- Fixed typos and logical mistakes in dialogs.

[h1]Planned:[/h1]
- Proofreading of episode 4,
- Translation of episode 5.

notes.title: Porting LDOD to Unity 5
notes.content:
We have finished porting Leviathan: The Last Day of the Decade to Unity 5!

Now our goal is:
[list]
    [*]To fix all previous bugs ((￣Д￣）tDarina).
    [*]Build Linux version.
    [*]Build Android version.
    [*]Deliver episodes 4 and 5 for iOS.
    [*]And to finish the translation.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

Andrey Kniazev and Lostwood Team!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

 Левиафан на Unity 5 😃 

👏 Ура, друзья! 👏 Мы закончили портирование на Unity 5. Теперь перед нами следующие задачи:

- исправить все существующие баги
- сделать Linux-версию
- сделать Android-версию 
- перенести 4-ый и 5-ый эпизоды на iOS
- перевести 5-ый эпизод на английский
Спасибо за вашу поддержку 👪 

С уважением,
команда Lostwood

notes.title: Welcome to International Community!
notes.content:
Hey, gamers!

We're pleased to inform you that we've launched a new website for INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY! 

We're aimed to make friends with international community! Check out our new forum and blog to keep in touch with Lostwood and people all over the world – share your own opinion and make themes to discuss everything you want and show your unique  fanart, fanfiction and memes based on the Leviathan setting.

Making contact with international community is something we aimed for now. And it's very important for us to provide you an exciting pastime! Go, be our guests.

You're always welcome: http://thelostwood.com/community/2015/07/30/welcome-to-international-community/

notes.title: Релиз 5-го эпизода\ Release of episode 5
notes.content:
[h1] Эпизод 5. Релиз.[/h1]

Друзья, мы всё улучшили!
[list]
 [*]переименовали Руф в Дарину в английской версии
 [*]убрали баг с неработающим телефоном
 [*]добавли 5-ый эпизод в русской версии
 [*]добавили 4-ый эпизод на английском и немецком в iOS
 [*]фастфорвард доступен всем
 [*]переделали полностью стим-ачивменты
 [*]исправили искажение "секретной фотографии"
 [*]улучшили анимации Дарины в детстве
 [*]убрали версионность игры[/list]
 [*] добавили MAC-версию

С любовью,
Lostwood.

[h1]Episode 5. Release.[/h1]

Fellows, we have improved everything!

 [*] renamed Ruth to Darina as she is called in Russian version
 [*] removed a bag with a broken phone
 [*] added episode 5 in Russian version
 [*] added episode 4 in English and German to the iOS version
 [*] fast forward is unlocked from the start
 [*] redone steam-achievements from scratch
 [*] fixed the low quality of "the secret photography"
 [*] improved Darina's animation in childhood
 [*] removed game revisions
 [*] added Mac-version

With love, 
Lostwood

notes.title: О 5-ом эпизоде / About episode 5
notes.content:
--- RUSSIAN VERSION / РУССКАЯ ВЕРСИЯ ---

1. Бета-версия на русском
2. Проблемы
[list]
[*]не работают сейвы (на данный момент просто стартуйте с 5-го эпизода) 
[*]не работает фаст форвард (и его хоткей ~)
[*]после 4-го эпизода не стартует 5ый.
[*]мы не знаем, работают ли все эпизоды, кроме 5-го.
[*]iOS и Мак версии выйдут позже.
[*]5-ый эпизод теперь стал тестовым и доступен будет только тем, кто сделал как показано на скриншотах. [/list]
ИНСТРУКЦИЯ: правой кнопкой мыши нажать Leviathan в Steam - Properties - вкладка BETA - ep5beta
Исправлено: 
[*]не стартует финальный диалог 
[*]при старте с 5-го, если выбрать добрую книгу, то она не исчезает.
На данный момент это всё, что нам известно. Мы занимаемся данными проблемами.

Сахарные, ваша поддержка нам очень важна. Мы стараемся всё сделать как можно скорее.

---ENGLISH VERSION---

Russian beta-version
Known problems:
[list]
[*]saves don’t work (just start ep.5)
[*]fast forward and its hotkey don’t work
[*]ep.5 can’t start after ep.4
[*] we don’t know whether all episodes work or don’t
[*]iOS & Mac versions will release later.
[*]Ep.5 is in beta-version now. It’s available after following the instruction: push Leviathan in Steam - Properties - BETA - ep5beta
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*]final dialog don’t start
[*]Kind book remains at the background when choosen.[/list]
It’s everything we know about problems. We keep working.

Sugar, your support is really important for us. We try to fix everything ASAP.
